code:
# No timeout on the cross-cloud call:
#   AWS dependency degrades (slow, not down)
#   -> every Azure call to it hangs instead of failing fast
#   -> each hung call holds a connection + thread open
#   -> Azure service exhausts its own capacity
#   -> a healthy service becomes unavailable too
#
# The AWS slowdown caused it; the Azure outage is what users see.
caption: The dependency degraded; the cascade is what the calling service's own design allowed to happen.

steps.label: Timeouts on every cross-cloud call
steps.sub: fails fast instead of hanging, freeing the connection immediately

steps.label: Circuit breakers
steps.sub: stop calling a failing dependency for a cooldown period
